guidance.heading: Rated by the sling, not the chain
guidance.body: A chain sling is rated for its make-up: the number of legs and the angle they work at decide what it may lift, and the weakest component sets the rating. Each page here is one make-up, named by its letter code, with the working load limit for every chain size. Pick the make-up by the fitting your load needs, then the chain size by the load and the leg angle, and tell us the reach.

standards.heading: Grade 80, Grade 100 and EN 818-4
standards.body: EN 818-4 sets the ratings for Grade 8 chain slings at a 4:1 design factor: a two-leg sling carries 1.4 times a single leg with the legs up to 45° from vertical, and a three- or four-leg sling 2.1 times. Grade 100 chain carries about 25% more for the same diameter and is rated on the same method. Chain, links and hooks in one sling are always the same grade.

items.q: How do I read the make-up code?
items.a: From the top down. The first letter is the number of legs: S single, D double, T triple, Q quad. The next is the top fitting, usually O for an oblong master link. The last is the bottom fitting: S sling hook, G grab hook, F foundry hook, SL self-locking hook, O oblong link. A DOS sling is a double-leg sling with a master link and sling hooks.

items.q: What is the difference between WLL, SWL and breaking load?
items.a: WLL — working load limit — is the most the manufacturer rates a part to carry in service. SWL, safe working load, is the older term and is sometimes set lower for a particular installation. The minimum breaking load is what the part withstood in test, several times its WLL, and it is never a working figure.

items.q: How often must a chain sling be examined in the UAE?

products.descriptionLong:
Grade 80 single-leg chain sling made up with an oblong master link at the top and a sling hook with safety latch at the bottom. The chain and every fitting are Grade 80 alloy steel, quenched and tempered, and matched in size so that no component is the weak point.

What SOS means

Chain sling make-ups are named by a letter code read from the top down: S = single leg; O = oblong master link; S = sling hook with safety latch. So an SOS sling is a single leg sling with an oblong master link at the top and a sling hook with safety latch at the bottom.

Sizes and ratings

21 chain sizes, 4 mm to 50 mm. Working load limit 0.5 to 78.5 t in a straight vertical lift, at a 4:1 design factor. Used in a choke hitch the rating falls to 80% of the figure in the table. Each size has its own Indus part number below.

Choosing this make-up

The oblong master link sits on the crane hook and lets the sling hang and turn freely. A sling hook is the general-purpose end fitting: the spring latch closes the throat so the hook cannot slip off a slack lifting point.

Identification and certificate

Each sling carries a permanent tag with its serial number, chain size, grade, reach and working load limit, and ships with the manufacturer's test certificate. The rating on the tag and certificate is the one that governs the sling in service.

Ordering

Slings are made up to length. Quote the Indus part number for the chain size and the reach you need, measured from the bearing point of the master link to the bearing point of the hook, or send the load, the number of lifting points and the headroom and we will size the sling for you.

products.descriptionLong:
Grade 80 single-leg chain sling made up with a sling hook with safety latch at the top and a grab hook at the bottom. The chain and every fitting are Grade 80 alloy steel, quenched and tempered, and matched in size so that no component is the weak point.

What SSG means

Chain sling make-ups are named by a letter code read from the top down: S = single leg; S = sling hook with safety latch; G = grab hook. So an SSG sling is a single leg sling with a sling hook with safety latch at the top and a grab hook at the bottom.

Sizes and ratings

21 chain sizes, 4 mm to 50 mm. Working load limit 0.5 to 78.5 t in a straight vertical lift, at a 4:1 design factor. Used in a choke hitch the rating falls to 80% of the figure in the table. Each size has its own Indus part number below.

Choosing this make-up

A sling hook is the general-purpose end fitting: the spring latch closes the throat so the hook cannot slip off a slack lifting point. A grab hook has a narrow throat that seats across a single chain link, so a leg can be hooked back onto its own chain to shorten it or to wrap the load.

Identification and certificate

Each sling carries a permanent tag with its serial number, chain size, grade, reach and working load limit, and ships with the manufacturer's test certificate. The rating on the tag and certificate is the one that governs the sling in service.

Ordering

Slings are made up to length. Quote the Indus part number for the chain size and the reach you need, measured from the bearing point of the top fitting to the bearing point of the hook, or send the load, the number of lifting points and the headroom and we will size the sling for you.

products.descriptionLong:
Grade 100 single-leg chain sling made up with an oblong master link at each end. The chain and every fitting are Grade 100 alloy steel, quenched and tempered, and matched in size so that no component is the weak point.

What SOO means

Chain sling make-ups are named by a letter code read from the top down: S = single leg; O = oblong master link; O = oblong master link. So an SOO sling is a single leg sling with an oblong master link at each end.

Sizes and ratings

11 chain sizes, 6 mm to 26 mm. Working load limit 1.4 to 26.5 t in a straight vertical lift, at a 4:1 design factor. Used in a choke hitch the rating falls to 80% of the figure in the table. Each size has its own Indus part number below.

Grade 100 against Grade 80

Grade 100 chain carries about 25% more than Grade 80 chain of the same diameter, so a given load can often be lifted on a sling one chain size smaller and lighter. The table gives the standard Grade 100 ratings, worked on the same method as EN 818-4. Chain above 26 mm is made to order and its rating is confirmed on the quotation.

Choosing this make-up

A plain oblong link at the working end is for shackling to a lifting lug or for coupling to another fitting on site.

Identification and certificate
